answer_text: Slow internet can be caused by sub-optimal routing. Please run a quick ping test and traceroute to your destination, and compare results when your traffic passes through Cato versus bypassing Cato to see where latency is introduced. If the latency is higher through Cato, that indicates a sub-optimal route to the server that we should investigate next. If you’re on Wi‑Fi, weak signal can also slow things down (watch for the Poor Wi‑Fi Notification).
